title: Say Bismillah
tip: Begin every action with 'Bismillah' — in the name of Allah — to gain barakah in your deeds.

title: The Power of Istighfar
tip: Seeking forgiveness (Astaghfirullah) opens doors of provision, removes distress, and brings rain of mercy.

title: Best Day of the Week
tip: Friday (Jumu'ah) is the best day. Read Surah Al-Kahf, send salawat on the Prophet ﷺ, and make abundant dua.

title: Night Prayer (Tahajjud)
tip: The closest a servant is to Allah is in the last third of the night. Rise for Tahajjud to have your duas answered.

title: Smile — It's Sadaqah
tip: A smile in the face of your brother is an act of charity (sadaqah). Small acts can carry great rewards.

title: Guard Your Tongue
tip: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent. (Bukhari)

title: Dhikr After Prayer
tip: Say SubhanAllah 33×, Alhamdulillah 33×, Allahu Akbar 34× after each prayer to magnify your rewards.

title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
tip: Reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas three times is equivalent to reciting the entire Quran once. (Bukhari)

title: Two Light Rak'ah
tip: Two rak'ah prayed with full concentration are better than a night spent in worship with a heedless heart.

title: The Prophet's ﷺ Dua
tip: Say: Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik — O Allah, help me remember You, thank You, and worship You well.

title: Charity Extinguishes Sin
tip: Charity (sadaqah) extinguishes sin as water extinguishes fire. (Tirmidhi) Give even a little regularly.

title: Benefits of Wudu
tip: Performing wudu washes away sins. On the Day of Judgement, Muslims will be recognized by the brightness of their limbs.

title: Visiting the Sick
tip: Visiting a sick Muslim earns 70,000 angels who pray for your forgiveness until evening. (Ahmad)

title: Ayatul Kursi Protection
tip: Recite Ayatul Kursi (2:255) after every obligatory prayer and before sleep for divine protection all day.

title: Be Kind to Parents
tip: Paradise lies under the feet of your mother. (Ibn Majah) A single act of kindness to your parents is enormous worship.

title: The Two Gardens
tip: Whoever prays Fajr in congregation, then sits remembering Allah until sunrise, then prays two rak'ah, gets the reward of Hajj and Umrah. (Tirmidhi)

title: Plant for the Akhirah
tip: If the Final Hour comes while you have a seedling in your hand, plant it. (Ahmad) Work for this world and the next.

title: Salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
tip: Whoever sends one salawat on me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him, erases ten sins, and raises him ten degrees. (Muslim)

title: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
tip: Two phrases light on the tongue but heavy on the Scale: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil Azeem. (Bukhari)

title: Hajj Every Year
tip: Perform Umrah and Hajj back to back — they remove poverty and sins as the bellows removes impurity from iron. (Nasai)

title: Recite Morning Adhkar
tip: Start your day with morning adhkar (Hisnul Muslim). It shields you throughout the day from harm and evil.

title: The Friday Gift
tip: There is a moment on Friday when no Muslim asks Allah for something except He grants it. Seek it in the last hour before Maghrib.

title: Make Dua for Others
tip: When you make dua for a fellow Muslim without their knowledge, the angel says 'And the same for you'. (Muslim)

title: Sunnah Fasts
tip: Fast Monday and Thursday — deeds are presented to Allah on these days, and the Prophet ﷺ loved his deeds to be presented while fasting.

title: Be Content
tip: Richness is not having many possessions, but richness is self-contentment (ghina an-nafs). (Bukhari)

title: The Quran Intercedes
tip: Recite the Quran, for it will come as an intercessor for its companions on the Day of Resurrection. (Muslim)

title: Removing Harm
tip: Removing something harmful from the road is an act of sadaqah. Small good deeds are never trivial.

title: Last Two Verses
tip: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him. (Bukhari)

title: Dua Enters Paradise
tip: Dua is the essence of worship. (Abu Dawud) Never stop making dua — even if the answer is delayed.

title: The Best Sadaqah
tip: The best sadaqah is that you give while you are healthy, fearing poverty, and hoping for wealth. (Bukhari)
